results.title: POS tags and part-of-speech tagging | Sketch Engine
results.content: A POS tag (or part-of-speech tag) is a label assigned to each token (word) in a text corpus to indicate the part of speech and often also other grammatical categories such as tense, number (plural/singular), case etc. POS tags are used in corpus searches and in text analysis tools and algorithms. A set of all POS tags used in a corpus is called a tagset. Upload your data/text into Sketch Engine to pos-tag and lemmatize them automatically. POS tags make it possible for automatic text processing tools to take into account which part of speech each word is. Nowadays, manual annotation is typically used to annotate a small corpus to be used as training data for the development of a new automatic POS tagger. The easiest way to tag your data for parts of speech is to use a ready-made solution such as uploading your texts to Sketch Engine, which already contains POS taggers for many languages. https://www.sketchengine.eu/wp-content/uploads/post-tags.png 301 392 2018-03-27 18:13:392024-08-09 12:21:59POS tags.
